criteriaRevision: 2026-09-03: user-approved separation of SC02 horizontal effectiveness and SC05 scaling responsiveness from the SC01 SRS latency target; original-v1 outcomes and continuity diagnostics retained.
notes: W=50 means 100 buildings with one sensor reporting every two seconds; the rate was fixed before measurements.
SC03 exercises the frontend-to-core live telemetry API with valid nonempty InfluxDB data, not browser rendering or authenticated metadata endpoints.
All service resource limits and local images are recorded; existing unrelated containers remain running.
SC05 uses an experimental local traffic-driven controller. It does not demonstrate an existing production autoscaler.
SC02 v2 requires lower p95 at the SAME 150/s workload, valid generators and <1% errors in both trials, all three API/worker replicas participating, and accepted-point persistence in both trials.

SC05 v2 requires measured sustained-load trigger, three healthy APIs and three running workers within 60s, valid measured traffic and accepted-point persistence. The original latency criterion and all warm-up request failures are separately reported.
SC01, SC03, SC04, all workloads, durations, resource limits and the original-v1 scoring remain unchanged. Applying v2 to old measurements is a retrospective reassessment, not a new benchmark.
